title: Icon button
description: A bookmark button with no label. The bookmark fills when you press it, and a short message confirms the item was saved.
iconsNote: This simple button uses a System Outline icon with the Morph state. Swap the bookmark for a heart, a cloud or any other System Outline icon with a Morph state. Icons with the default Hover state work too, but instead of turning solid, they play the full animation and only change color.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The button, its icon and the toast
fragments.note: The bookmark fills and empties with aria-pressed, and nothing else.

fragments.title: Flip the attribute, show the toast
fragments.note: The toast shows for two seconds after saving, and goes when you unsave.

fragments.title: Colour from the same attribute
fragments.note: Ink at rest, accent once saved. The icon inherits it through current-color.

fragments.title: The toast rising in
fragments.note: One attribute shows it; a transition does the rest.
